title: 第四十二章 西蜀寻灵脉万年天道局第四十一章 岁岁烟火暖灵脉暗潮生
lines: 天下灵脉异动愈演愈烈。
朝堂公文一日三至，各州府加急奏报雪花般送入王府。北疆雪原夜生极光幻雾，江南山林灵气逆流，西蜀群山更是频繁地动，草木枯荣颠倒，四时乱象丛生。
朝野百官人心惶惶，却无人能勘破根源，只当是天地灵气失序。
王府暖阁之内，天光静好。
沈清鸢指尖轻点桌案上的天下灵脉舆图，眸光沉静澄澈，将所有异动点位一一串联。
所有紊乱之地，连成一条横贯大靖山河的长线，终点直指西蜀灵山。
那是万年之前，清玄宗尚未立宗、初代圣女降生的原始灵脉源头。
“异动根源，在西蜀灵山。”
沈清鸢抬眸看向身侧的萧聿辞，轻声道，“人间伪宗棋局已碎，如今扰动天地的，是最古老的天道本源。”
萧聿辞俯身，指尖覆上她微凉的手背，眸色温柔又凝重：“我陪你去。”
他早已遣暗卫提前封锁西蜀全境，清剿山野异动邪杂，杜绝百姓恐慌。朝堂政务全权交由心腹重臣打理，无需他坐镇京都。
乱世纷争他陪她浴血厮杀，天道变局，他亦寸步不离。
一日休整，二人低调简装，褪去王妃、王爷尊荣，化作寻常江湖侠侣，轻车简从，西行入蜀。
无百官相送，无仪仗随行，只带两名顶尖暗卫隐匿随行。
一路山河锦绣，春风遍野。
脱离京城朝堂的繁文缛节，二人一路并肩慢行，赏山川风月，享难得的松弛自在。
马车之内，暖意融融。
沈清鸢倚在萧聿辞怀中，看着窗外飞速倒退的青山绿水，轻声轻叹：“从前步步是局，步步是险，从未敢这般从容看山河。”
萧聿辞抬手，温柔揉散她鬓边微风，低头抵着她的额角，嗓音缱绻温柔：“往后每一场山河风月，我都陪你慢慢看。”
“人间盛世、天道风云，凡你所见，我皆相伴。”
他低头落吻，细碎温柔，落在眉眼、唇角，缠绵缱绻，将一路温柔尽数赠予她。
历经生死并肩，彼此的爱意早已融进骨血，无需张扬，岁岁沉淀，愈发情深。
三日车程，抵达西蜀灵山地界。
此处山高万仞，云雾常年不散，是天下最纯粹的灵脉发源地。
可此刻踏入山林，满目诡异乱象。
春日时节，山前繁花盛放，山后草木枯黄，一边生机盎然，一边死气沉沉。天地灵气忽顺忽逆，风无定向，云无定形，处处透着扭曲的天道规则。
“好强的轮回气息。”
沈清鸢踏出马车，血脉微微发烫，墨玉玉佩悬空轻颤，莹白微光忽明忽暗。
这不是血煞邪气，是清冷、宏大、无情的天道轮回之力。
公正，冰冷，万世不变，不以人情为转移。
“小心。”萧聿辞下意识将她护在身前，金龙气纹隐于周身，随时可御敌破局。
二人并肩踏入深山腹地。
越往灵山深处走，天地异象越重，周遭云雾渐渐扭曲成无数重叠的人影虚影，女子身姿、眉眼各异，却都带着同样的悲悯与无奈。
代代圣女残影，浮沉云雾之间。
content_en:
The spiritual changes in the world are getting more and more intense.
Official documents from the court arrived three times a day, and reports from various states rushed to the palace like snowflakes. The northern Xinjiang snowfields have phantom auroras at night, the spiritual energy of the mountains and forests in the south of the Yangtze River flows backwards, and the mountains in Western Sichuan are frequently moving. The vegetation is withered and upside down, and the four seasons are full of chaos.
Officials in both the government and the public were panic-stricken, but no one could find out the root cause. They could only think that the spiritual energy of heaven and earth was out of order.
Inside the Nuan Pavilion of the Royal Palace, the sky is quiet and quiet.
Shen Qingyuan tapped the map of the world's spiritual veins on the table with her fingertips. Her eyes were calm and clear, connecting all the changing points one by one.
All the chaotic places are connected into a long line across the mountains and rivers of Dajing, and the end point is directly towards the West Shuling Mountain.
That was the source of the original spiritual veins from which the first generation of saints was born thousands of years ago, before the Qing Xuan Sect was established.
"The source of the strange movement is in the Western Shuling Mountain."
Shen Qingyuan raised his eyes to look at Xiao Yuci beside him, and said softly, "The chess game of the pseudo-sect in the world has been broken. What is disturbing the world now is the oldest source of heaven."
Xiao Yuci leaned over and placed his fingertips on the back of her cold hand, his eyes gentle and solemn: "I'll go with you."
He had already sent secret guards to blockade the entire territory of Xishu in advance, clearing out any movement and evil in the mountains and fields, and preventing the people from panic. The government affairs of the court are fully handled by his trusted ministers, and there is no need for him to sit in Kyoto.
In troubled times, he accompanies her in bloody fights, and even when the fate of heaven changes, he never leaves her.
After a day's rest, the two of them dressed in low-key simple clothes, shed their dignity as princesses and princes, and turned into ordinary heroes and heroines, traveling westward to Sichuan in a simple carriage.
There were no officials to see him off, no ceremonial guards to accompany him, and only two top secret guards to accompany him in secret.
The mountains and rivers are beautiful all the way, and the spring breeze is everywhere.
Breaking away from the red tape of the capital court, the two walked slowly side by side, admiring the mountains, rivers, wind and moon, and enjoying the rare relaxation and freedom.
Inside the carriage, it was warm and cozy.
Shen Qingyuan leaned in Xiao Yuci's arms, looking at the rapidly retreating green mountains and green waters outside the window, and sighed softly: "In the past, every step was a situation, and every step was a danger. I have never dared to look at the mountains and rivers so calmly."
Xiao Yuci raised his hand, gently rubbed away the breeze on her temples, lowered his head to touch her forehead, and said in a gentle voice, "I will accompany you to watch every scene in the mountains and rivers from now on."
"Everything you see in the prosperous times of the world and the storms of heaven, I will be with you."
He lowered his head and kissed her, softly and softly, touching her eyebrows and corners of her lips, lingering and tenderness, giving her all the tenderness along the way.
Having been side by side through life and death, our love for each other has long been integrated into our bones and blood, and there is no need to show it off. As time goes by, our love becomes deeper and deeper.
After three days' drive, we arrived at the boundary of Xishu Lingshan Mountain.
The mountains here are tens of thousands of feet high, and the clouds and mist never dissipate all year round. It is the birthplace of the purest spiritual veins in the world.
But now when I step into the forest, I see strange and chaotic scenes.
In spring, flowers bloom in front of the mountains, while the grass and trees behind the mountains are withered and yellow. One side is full of life, and the other side is lifeless. The spiritual energy of heaven and earth alternately goes smoothly and reversely, the wind has no direction, the clouds have no shape, and the twisted rules of heaven are everywhere.
"What a strong breath of reincarnation."
Shen Qingyuan stepped out of the carriage, his blood was slightly hot, the ink jade pendant trembled slightly in the air, and the crystal white light flickered on and off.
This is not the evil spirit of blood, but the cold, grand, and ruthless power of heaven and reincarnation.
Fair, cold, unchangeable, and unchangeable by human feelings.
"Be careful." Xiao Yuci subconsciously protected her in front of him. The golden dragon aura pattern was hidden all over his body, so he could fend off the enemy at any time.
The two of them stepped into the deep mountains side by side.
As we walked deeper into Lingshan Mountain, the visions of heaven and earth became more intense. The surrounding clouds and mist gradually distorted into countless overlapping human silhouettes. The women's postures, eyebrows and eyes were different, but they all carried the same compassion and helplessness.
The afterimages of the saints from generation to generation float among the clouds and mists.
